frontend.services: client/src/services/index.js exposes helpers for auth, media, instructor courses/live class plans, student catalog/orders/progress/tickets, admin dashboards/users/courses/finance/categories/roadmaps/tickets, and category/roadmap lookups.

routing.App: client/src/App.jsx configures RouteGuard with nested admin, instructor, and student layouts plus student home, catalog, roadmaps, course progress, live plan details, tickets, about, and NotFound.

frontend.notes: Components reference client/src/config for form controls and translation keys. Contexts expose setters so pages can coordinate popups, forms, and lists.

flows.name: Student course purchase
sequence: Frontend calls createPaymentService to POST /student/orders/create; order-controller decides if course is free or requires Stripe checkout session.
Order document is saved, StudentCourses document is upserted, and Course.students array plus revenue counters update.
Frontend may call captureAndFinalizePaymentService (POST /student/orders/capture) if additional confirmation is needed, reusing enrollStudentInCourse helper, then redirects student to course content.

flows.name: Course progress tracking
sequence: Student requests GET /student/course-progress/get/:courseId; controller ensures StudentCourses exists before returning course + CourseProgress.
Marking lectures viewed hits POST /student/course-progress/mark-lecture-viewed, updates or creates CourseProgress, and sets completed/completionDate when every Curriculum lecture is marked viewed.
Reset progress calls POST /student/course-progress/reset-progress to clear lecture flags and completion metadata so the course can be replayed.

flows.name: Ticket support loop
sequence: Student creates ticket via POST /student/tickets/create; ticket initial message stored with senderRole 'user'.
Admin reviews /admin/tickets, calls POST /admin/tickets/:ticketId/reply which pushes admin replies, auto-assigns, and can update status to in-progress/resolved.
Both student and admin controllers call Ticket.markAsRead so unread counts stay accurate; clients refresh via getUserTicketsService or getAllTicketsService.

flows.name: Live class plan lifecycle
sequence: Instructor posts /instructor/live-class-plans with validated dates/times; ensureCourseOwnership links optional courseId to an instructor-owned course.
Plan can be updated, archived, or published (PATCH /:id/publish) while verifying ownership and status restrictions.
Student clients fetch /student/live-class-plans and /student/live-class-plans/:id; only plans with status 'published' reach public views.

connections.name: Auth tokens
connections.description: AuthContext writes tokens to sessionStorage, axiosInstance attaches the accessToken to each request, auth-middleware validates it and reloads User, and admin-middleware enforces role checks.

connections.name: Instructor media path
connections.description: /media endpoints rely on multer storing files under server/uploads/<instructor-email>, Cloudinary helper uploads each file, and cleanup removes temp paths afterward.

connections.name: Category and roadmap data
connections.description: CategoryController.ensureDefaultCategories seeds defaults, CategoryProvider fetches /categories, and RoadmapController pulls Course titles to enrich admin/public roadmaps.
